globalInsight.title: The calendar agent books the right meeting at the wrong local time
globalInsight.hook: Watch one timezone field break an otherwise correct AI agent
globalInsight.script: A split screen shows the agent accepting a 9 AM request, placing it at 9 AM UTC instead of Kyiv time, then rerunning after the timezone field is added.
globalInsight.marketingMechanics: apparently correct automation -> hidden timezone conflict -> one-field correction -> visible successful rerun

video.videoSummary: A split-screen debugging demo exposes and fixes a timezone mismatch.
video.contentMechanic: hidden timezone conflict revealed through before/correction/after screen proof

globalInsight.title: One paper ticket blocks the bakery's entire morning queue
globalInsight.hook: The oven is free, but every order is still late
globalInsight.script: A top-down shot follows paper order tickets piling behind one custom cake. The baker moves that ticket to a separate lane and the normal queue starts moving again.
globalInsight.marketingMechanics: visible queue bottleneck -> isolate exceptional job -> throughput resumes

video.videoSummary: Paper tickets make a process bottleneck visible and a lane change resolves it.
video.contentMechanic: move one exceptional job out of the shared queue to restore flow

globalInsight.title: A student teaches the fraction back and exposes the misconception
globalInsight.hook: She got the answer right but cannot rebuild it with blocks
globalInsight.script: The teacher asks a student to explain three quarters using four colored blocks. The first arrangement reveals a denominator misconception, then the student corrects it aloud.
globalInsight.marketingMechanics: correct answer challenged by teach-back -> physical model reveals misconception -> learner self-corrects

video.videoSummary: A teach-back with colored blocks turns an invisible misconception into visible evidence.
video.contentMechanic: ask learner to rebuild the answer physically, reveal the misconception, then self-correct

globalInsight.title: The first customer voice note after the ceramics studio nearly closed
globalInsight.hook: She kept one unheard message from the week she packed the studio
globalInsight.script: The creator opens with sealed moving boxes, plays a short customer voice note, then cuts to reopening one shelf and firing the first new cup. The final shot is the customer's pickup reaction.
globalInsight.marketingMechanics: near-closure vulnerability -> personal voice-note catalyst -> one small rebuilding action -> earned emotional payoff

video.videoSummary: A saved customer message turns a near-closure story into one concrete act of reopening.
video.contentMechanic: vulnerable low point, intimate audio catalyst, small rebuild, earned payoff

globalInsight.title: A silent match cut turns a cable tangle into a labeled workstation
globalInsight.hook: No talking: one snap changes chaos into a working desk
globalInsight.script: In a locked overhead shot, a hand drops a tangled cable bundle. On the finger snap, match cuts progressively replace it with three labeled cables connected to the correct devices. Only a countdown is on screen.
globalInsight.marketingMechanics: silent visual chaos -> repeated match-cut transformations -> labeled functional payoff

video.videoSummary: A silent fixed-camera transformation resolves visible cable chaos in three match cuts.
video.contentMechanic: repeat the same match cut three times while labels make the final system legible
